Game Overview

In Headlight Heroes, the core idea is straightforward: control two cars at once in Headlight Heroes, a fast-paced highway thrill ride that tests your reflexes and coordination. Swiftly switch lanes to dodge traffic, avoid crashes, and collect flags for bonus points. With increasing speed and difficulty, can you keep both cars on the road?
